name: Ertian and the Magical Egg
source:
When easy-going Yang Ertian receives a magical egg, it is up to him to hatch it – by making out with other young men!

[From [url=https://linxuelian.itch.io/vn-ertianegg]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当随和的杨二天收到一颗神奇的蛋时，就由他来孵化它——通过与其他年轻人亲热！

[来自[url=https://linxuelian.itch.io/vn-ertianegg]Itch.io[/url]]
